desc: Derive the exact DP state representation, including how to distinguish empty subsequences from valid product-1 subsequences.
Bound the possible alternating-sum range using `12 * n` and determine offset/indexing.
Implement product-centric bitset DP by selected-length parity and exact product.
Implement positive-value transitions with product-limit filtering and alternating-sum shifts.
Implement zero transitions that collapse products to zero while preserving sums and flipping parity.
Guard singleton transitions with `x <= limit` to avoid out-of-range indexing.
Validate samples and targeted edge cases, including zero values, k=0, product-1 paths, and out-of-range k; confirm runtime and memory behavior.
